recipes.title: Rich Indian Masala Chai
recipes.description: A steaming cup of classic Indian morning tea with milk, Assam CTC tea leaves, and aromatic cardamom & ginger.
instructions: Boil 1 cup of fresh water in a saucepan.
Add crushed ginger and 2 tbsp Tata Tea Gold leaves. Simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour in 1 cup of Amul Taaza milk and add sugar to taste.
Bring to a rolling boil 3 times on medium flame.
Strain through a fine sieve into kulhads or cups and serve hot!

recipes.title: Classic Fluffy Egg Omelette & Butter Toast
recipes.description: High-protein breakfast made with fresh brown eggs, chopped onions, and golden Amul butter.
instructions: Crack 2 eggs into a bowl, add salt, a pinch of pepper, and whisk vigorously until frothy.
Melt 1 tbsp Amul butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour the whisked eggs and tilt the pan to cover evenly.
Cook for 2 minutes until bottom is golden, fold gently and serve with buttered toast.
